current_truth: Windows x64 is the first Studio installer proof target because current Tauri NSIS evidence is x64-local.
Windows ARM64 is a reasonable follow-up target, but it needs its own Rust/MSVC target install, build, and clean-machine smoke.
Windows 32-bit remains deferred until user demand justifies separate WebView2 and installer QA.
Linux Studio package format remains open until a Linux desktop launch proves the shell runtime.
macOS Studio remains the separate SwiftUI Apple reference lane, not a Tauri port claim.
This script records or reports installer proof; it does not run installers on the current host.

package_targets.proof_required: Build on Windows, install unsigned NSIS in a fresh x64 VM, launch, and run --studio-smoke.
Install ARM64 Rust/MSVC components, build with --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc, and smoke on Windows ARM64 hardware or VM.
Only add when product demand justifies WebView2, installer, and clean-VM QA for 32-bit Windows.
Launch the Tauri shell in a Linux desktop session and run CLI plus advisory evidence smoke.
Select package surface after x64 Linux launch proof and validate GUI dependencies on ARM64.

package_targets.package_surface: SwiftUI Studio reference app, not the Windows/Linux Tauri shell
